title: The Courtly Pursuit
intro: In the corridors of power, a figure of high status became infatuated with a servant whose beauty was otherworldly. This infatuation led to a series of events that would test loyalties, reveal hidden truths, and ultimately affirm the servant's innocence.
clues: I lived in the land of the Nile, in a palace of great influence.
A young man came into my household, and his presence unsettled my world.
I tried to seduce him, but he sought refuge in his Lord.
I tore his garment from behind, but the evidence pointed to my deceit.
To silence the gossip of the noblewomen, I invited them to a gathering and placed sharp objects in their hands.
In the end, I publicly confessed my fault, acknowledging the truth before the king.

arabic: قَالَ مَا خَطْبُكُنَّ إِذْ رَٰوَدتُّنَّ يُوسُفَ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ ۚ قُلْنَ حَـٰشَ لِلَّهِ مَا عَلِمْنَا عَلَيْهِ مِن سُوٓءٍۢ ۚ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْـَٔـٰنَ حَصْحَصَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَنَا۠ رَٰوَدتُّهُۥ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verse: Said [the king to the women], "What was your condition when you sought to seduce Joseph?" They said, "Perfect is Allāh! We know about him no evil." The wife of al-ʿAzeez said, "Now the truth has become evident. It was I who sought to seduce him, and indeed, he is of the truthful. (12:51)
